Switzerland

SIUS AG

SIUS develops electronic target systems for sport and institutional applications. Its official portfolio includes electronic targets for multiple disciplines, range-control infrastructure, scoring and ranking software, EventTV, competition services and related support.

VTI supports SIUS systems in Bangladesh through requirement coordination, supply, installation assistance, troubleshooting and local service communication.

Germany

BKE HITCOM GmbH

BKE HITCOM plans and supplies indoor shooting-range and training technology. Its published capabilities cover the HITCOM visual scoring system, static and interactive training modules, simulation options, mechanical targets, screen units, bullet traps, consulting, installation and maintenance.

VTI coordinates BKE HITCOM requirements for Bangladesh projects and provides the local interface for project discussion and technical support.

HITCOM systemsSimulationMechanical targetsBullet trapsScreen units

France

LAPORTE

LAPORTE has manufactured clay targets and launchers since 1927. Its official product range covers Olympic and universal trench, Olympic and universal skeet, sporting and Compak, DTL, American Trap, individual training, targets and simulated-game equipment.

VTI supports LAPORTE equipment in Bangladesh through product coordination, institutional supply and local service assistance.

Clay launchersSkeet & trapSporting & CompakClay targets

Germany

ahg-ANSCHÜTZ

ahg Anschütz Handels GmbH is a full-service supplier for sport shooters. The official range includes competition clothing, footwear, gloves, sights, iris diaphragms, shooting glasses, transport cases, bags, spotting scopes, tuning accessories and care products.

VTI supports access to relevant ahg product categories and coordinates product and after-sales enquiries in Bangladesh.

Competition apparelSightsBags & casesTuning accessoriesCare products

Germany

J.G. ANSCHÜTZ

Founded in 1856, J.G. ANSCHÜTZ is a German family manufacturer of precision sporting and hunting rifles. Its sports portfolio includes target air rifles, small-bore rifles, biathlon equipment and associated sights and accessories.

VTI supports institutional and sports-shooting enquiries for relevant ANSCHÜTZ product categories in Bangladesh.
